Messages.Body:
Q1: We recently had a thread about 2nd Tradition - especially one thing
was rather new to me (except from the fact that I originally raised the
question *LOL* ); does the reacting Prince/Justicar need to actually
attempt to BLOCK the action or is it enough for him to react to the
action by untapping and playing a reaction card?! Is it necessary for
the reacting minion actually to be able to block - following the wording
of "Volker - The Puppet Prince", who is not able to block primogen., in
order to use 2nd Tradition?? Is it not possible for "Volker" to use 2nd
Trad. to untap and play, lets say, a deflection (even if the acting
minion haven't got +2 stealth yet)???

Q2: Do playing an action modifier like bonding, actually require the
current action to be a bleed action or could the acting minion use
bonding at superior in order to gain the +1 stealth (and +1 bleed) for
any other action????

Thanks in advance!

Claus Staal

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <5563b5e0c17cd7d0fa5...@mygate.mailgate.org>,

Claus Staal <c...@mbureauet.dk> writes:
>Q1: We recently had a thread about 2nd Tradition - especially one thing
>was rather new to me (except from the fact that I originally raised the
>question *LOL* ); does the reacting Prince/Justicar need to actually
>attempt to BLOCK the action

Yes.

> or is it enough for him to react to the
>action by untapping and playing a reaction card?!

No.

>Is it necessary for
>the reacting minion actually to be able to block - following the wording
>of "Volker - The Puppet Prince", who is not able to block primogen., in
>order to use 2nd Tradition??

You can't play something you can't do - e.g. you can't Eagle's Sight an
unblockable action. This seems parallel, so I'd say no.

>Is it not possible for "Volker" to use 2nd
>Trad. to untap and play, lets say, a deflection (even if the acting
>minion haven't got +2 stealth yet)???

No, you have to attempt a block.

>Q2: Do playing an action modifier like bonding, actually require the
>current action to be a bleed action or could the acting minion use
>bonding at superior in order to gain the +1 stealth (and +1 bleed) for
>any other action????

No, it has to be a bleed action. You can't add bleed to non-bleed
actions.
